# Northmark Chimney
> Chimney cleaning, inspection, repair and maintenance for homeowners in Toronto and the GTA. Phone (289) 514-5267. Every Day 7:00–22:00. The inspection visit is free, at the customer's home, with the exact price given on the spot before any work starts.

## Facts
- Phone: (289) 514-5267
- Email: Northmarkchimney@gmail.com
- Hours: Every Day 7:00–22:00
- Service area: Toronto, York, East York, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, Mississauga, Brampton, Vaughan, Concord, Thornhill, Richmond Hill, Markham, Oakville, Burlington, Milton, Halton Hills, Caledon, Ajax, Pickering, Whitby, Oshawa, Clarington, Newmarket, Aurora, King City, Stouffville, Uxbridge
- The inspection visit is free and takes place at the customer's home; camera photos of what is found; the exact price is given on the spot before any work begins; no obligation.
- WETT-certified technician. 3+ years in business. 2,000+ chimneys serviced.
- Every job carries a warranty covering both materials and labour.
- Current offer: standard chimney sweep $200 this winter, free inspection included.
- Google Maps / Business Profile: https://share.google/HRH623MMM2RBJ27UI
